positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: ▪ Own the lifecycle and maintenance of mission-critical QRC applications, managing a fault-tolerant distributed processing architecture designed for concurrent processing and seamless node continuity across volatile networks.

positions.title: Image Scientist
positions.description:
Note: Role originally with Maxar Technologies; acquired by Arka Group, LP (Nov '24) and CACI International (Mar '26).

▪ Provide subject matter expertise in remote sensing, image formation, and digital signal processing. Conduct image product quality assessments using custom scripts and specialized tools to evaluate the performance of sensors.
▪ Utilize the Python image science and data science stacks (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, SciPy, Pillow, Flask) to create mission optimization, automation, and monitoring tools. 
▪ Develop and maintain an object detection and image segmentation algorithm using statistical and morphological computer vision techniques, including multi-pass kernel filtering, feature extraction, binary masking, and connected-component labeling to automatically detect and measure ground-truth sites.
▪ Created a data visualization application that queries multiple REST APIs for recent data, filters and aggregates results into DataFrames, and displays them via Flask for 24/7 operators.
▪ Leverage knowledge of image processing, signal processing, phenomenology, artifacts, and system architecture to create and implement mitigation strategies, optimizing sensor performance and increasing product quality.
▪ Monitor and troubleshoot imagery products from sensors by performing daily imagery reviews and creating tools to automate metric cataloging, such as average geolocation error, daily data ingestion numbers, and average power distribution histogram mean values.
▪ Serve as the Product Quality Engineering point of contact on an integrated planning team, preparing for the implementation of future resilient architecture. Interface with various external teams to provide a Product Quality Engineering perspective on potential obstacles.
▪ Create and maintain Oracle Business reports and SQL Developer queries tracking high-priority sensor health and performance metrics for internal engineering teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Image Processing · Signal Processing · Automation · Dashboard Building · Image Science · Algorithm Development · Image Segmentation · Computer Vision · OpenCV

▪ Determine current section capabilities to identify gaps in knowledge and provide subsequent intelligence training requirements.

positions.title: GEOINT Training Application Developer
positions.description:
▪ Lead the modernization of the internal training team for an IC office. Spearheaded the front-end development of a new webpage containing usage guides, product information, and a glossary designed for new office members.
▪ Write responsive HTML/CSS within Adobe RoboHelp to create interactive landing pages, optimize user navigation between pages and from landing pages, save user preferences, bookmark pages, and improve website performance.
▪ Oversee the full lifecycle of webpage development. Coordinate with software developers, prime contract/government customers, and information security teams to assure both the compliance and usefulness of the new training website.
▪ Develop Computer-Based Training (CBT) using Adobe Captivate and record/edit technical demonstration videos using Adobe Premier Pro.
▪ Assist in the instruction of in person training covering the specifications, science/phenomenology, and usage of sensitive GEOINT collection sources. Training curriculum was organized into three separate classes for introductory, intermediate, and advanced level GEOINT analysts, scientists, and collection managers.

positions.title: GEOINT Hybrid Analyst
positions.description:
▪ Senior analyst and team lead; authored, reviewed, and published over 1000 reports via GETS while managing mission elements in support of the 513th IGD.
▪ Utilize machine learning and automation techniques to collect geospatial data, compile using JEMA, and perform data analysis to determine significance and trends using ArcGIS Pro and Python (ArcPy) scripts.
▪ Conduct long-term target studies using specially processed Geospatial Imagery (Radar, Thermal IR, Multispectral, Panchromatic, MTI, LiDAR, etc.) and create imagery/map derived reporting and graphics.
▪ Independently provide quality control assurance, release reporting, and provide guidance to multiple fellow analysts for the 513th IGD.
▪ Manage 513th mission elements by ensuring ingestion of GEOINT data via ETPR, automating operational workflows, conducting cross-domain transfers of reporting for the 513th and additional agencies, and assisting customers with feedback and requests.

positions.title: Imagery Analyst
positions.description:
▪ Battle Damage Assessment (BDA) analyst supporting OCONUS operations on overnight shift. Authored over 1100 reports in support of the 513th IGD and joint organization’s missions.
▪ Conducted phase 1 pattern-of-life Full Spectrum GEOINT analysis of high priority targets on overnight shift to enable 24-hour mission support for 513th customers.
▪ Utilized and interpreted data from additional intelligence disciplines to enhance reporting, including SIGINT, HUMINT, and MASINT.
